criteria.id: a project can discover GitHub Actions, Gitea Actions, or GitLab CI workflows
an authorized hosted pipeline trigger records an executed CI run on the WorkItem
hosted trigger waits until the run has completed before attaching evidence
JUnit, coverage, SARIF, and Playwright artifacts attach as executed CI evidence
local command-runner CI still works without GitHub
unknown provider or missing hosted workflow metadata fails loud
hosted credentials are supplied at call time or from the environment and are never persisted
production hosted CI still requires human approval
